_why: Classification F1 says whether a clause was labelled correctly. It says nothing
about whether the RANKING is useful - and the ranking is the actual product.
A system can label all 39 clauses perfectly and still put the room-rent cap at
number 14, below a clause that merely lets the insurer request a medical exam.
These expectations are hand-authored from how Indian health insurance claims
actually go wrong, not from what the model happened to output. They are
deliberately written BEFORE looking at a ranking, so they measure the system
'must_rank_top' clauses are the ones a policyholder most needs to see. Room-rent
capping combined with proportionate deduction is the single most common cause of
a large unexpected shortfall in an Indian cashless claim; the 24-hour notice
requirement is the most common technical repudiation.
'must_not_rank_top' clauses are consequential-sounding but low-impact: powers the
insurer must exercise at its own expense, administrative machinery, or
definitions that carry no direct claim consequence on their own.

must_rank_top.reason: Room rent cap. Combined with 5.2, breaching it reduces the entire bill proportionately - the most common cause of a large unexpected shortfall.
Proportionate deduction. Turns a room-category choice into an across-the-board cut on surgeon, anaesthetist and theatre charges.
24-hour notice requirement. The most common technical ground for repudiating an otherwise valid claim.
36-month pre-existing disease waiting period. Affects most buyers over 40, and is what people most often assume they are covered for.
20% senior-citizen co-payment. Applies to every claim for a large class of policyholder, permanently.

must_not_rank_top.reason: The Company may require a medical examination AT ITS OWN EXPENSE. A power the insurer must pay to exercise is not a financial risk to the policyholder.
Grievance redressal. Administrative, and exists to help the policyholder.
Definition of Sum Insured. Carries no claim consequence on its own.
Free-look period. A consumer protection, not a risk.
